channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: “Quem é esse cara?”, diz Lula sobre Javier Milei
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva mocked Argentine President Javier Milei by responding "Who is this guy?" when asked about Milei’s comments during a meeting with South Korea’s president. Milei had labeled Lula a "Lula risk," called Justice Alexandre de Moraes "bald trash," and denounced socialism, escalating diplomatic tensions. Brazil’s foreign ministry summoned both ambassadors in protest, signaling serious dissatisfaction without breaking diplomatic ties.

item.title: Vieira recebe embaixador do Brasil na Argentina após fala de Milei
item.description: Foreign Minister Mauro Vieira met in Brasília with Brazil's ambassador to Argentina, Júlio Bitelli, following harsh criticisms by Argentine President Javier Milei against the Brazilian government. Milei labeled Lula a 'Lula risk' and Justice Minister Alexandre de Moraes a 'bald trash', prompting Brazil to file a formal protest. Vieira will travel to Lima to represent Lula at the inauguration of Peru's president-elect, Keiko Fujimori.

item.title: A reação de Lula às ofensas proferidas por Javier Milei
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva responded lightly to Argentine President Javier Milei's insults, jokingly asking 'Who is this guy?' when questioned by reporters. Milei, during a visit to Brazil, called Lula a 'convict' and referred to Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes as 'bald trash', while also criticizing Brazil's judiciary and fiscal policy. Despite Lula's casual tone, the Brazilian government recalled its ambassador from Argentina for explanations, and Finance Minister Dário Durigan labeled Milei a 'clown'.

item.title: Fernanda Bolsonaro posta vídeo romântico com Flávio após convenção
item.description: Fernanda Bolsonaro, wife of PL presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro, posted a romantic video with him after the party's national convention in São Paulo, where he was officially nominated. In the caption, she expressed faith in a 'new story for Brazil' and reaffirmed her support for him. During the event, Fernanda made her political debut, stating she is not a politician but spoke as a woman, mother, professional, and Brazilian, criticizing the tax burden on entrepreneurs.

item.title: Renan Santos faz ofensiva pelo agro e recebe elogios de ex-secretário de Lula e ex-ministro de Temer
item.description: Renan Santos, pre-candidate of the Missão party for the Brazilian presidency, conducted a series of meetings in the Center-West region to engage with agribusiness, receiving praise from former Agriculture Ministers Blairo Maggi and Neri Geller, as well as former governor Mauro Mendes. At the Global Agribusiness Festival in Sorriso (MT), Santos presented proposals including toughening laws against land grabbing, revising Agrarian Reform, and implementing a permanent technical audit of MEC educational materials to counter what he calls 'anti-agro narratives' in schools. Supporters highlighted his role as a renewing alternative amid political polarization.

item.title: Nunes Marques será relator de ação do PT contra Flávio por vídeo de IA de Bolsonaro
item.description: TSE President Minister Kassio Nunes Marques will serve as rapporteur for a lawsuit filed by the PT-PV-PCdoB federation against Senator Flávio Bolsonaro and the PL over an AI-generated video simulating a speech by former President Jair Bolsonaro during the party's convention. The action challenges the use of manipulated content for electoral purposes, alleging potential abuse of power and disinformation.

item.title: Durigan meteu-se em palhaçada
item.description: Finance Minister Dario Durigan criticized Javier Milei by calling him a 'clown', apparently in an attempt to please President Lula. The remark, however, was seen as inappropriate and worsened existing tensions, as the Argentine government, led by Milei, had intensified confrontations during the event formalizing Flávio Bolsonaro’s candidacy. The incident sparked controversy and was interpreted as a diplomatic misstep.

item.title: Zema elogia Joaquim Barbosa como possível vice: “Carreira irretocável”
item.description: Romeu Zema, the Presidential candidate from the Novo party, praised retired Supreme Court Justice Joaquim Barbosa for his 'irreproachable' career and lack of conduct that would discredit him, emphasizing anti-corruption as Barbosa's main banner. Zema said he has already spoken with Barbosa and plans to meet him in Rio de Janeiro in the first week of August to invite him as his running mate, though he did not rule out forming a ticket with another Novo candidate.

item.title: Romeu Zema: "Três frutas podres no STF precisam ser substituídas"
item.description: Romeu Zema, presidential candidate from the Novo Party, stated that three STF ministers need to be replaced, referring to them as 'rotten fruits'. He accused the ministers of involvement in suspicious contracts, dubious transactions, and receiving support for legal congresses funded by a 'criminal banker', claiming they all benefited from flights on his private jet. Zema also criticized Brazil’s political model, likening it to a 'banana republic', and highlighted the country’s historic level of public indebtedness.

item.title: As conversas do embaixador do Brasil na Argentina com Lula e Mauro Vieira no Itamaraty
item.description: Brazil's ambassador to Argentina, Júlio Bitelli, met with Foreign Minister Mauro Vieira and briefly with President Lula at the Itamaraty to discuss the diplomatic fallout from Javier Milei's criticisms of Alexandre de Moraes and Lula at a Flávio Bolsonaro event. The Brazilian government responded with remarks from ministers Dario Durigan and Guilherme Boulos, who called Milei a 'clown'. Lula, when asked about the Argentine president, replied ironically: 'Who is this guy?'.

item.title: Segurança reforça Flávio; tarifaço divide Congresso, aponta pesquisa
item.description: The U.S. designation of PCC and Comando Vermelho as terrorist organizations is seen as an electoral asset for the opposition in the 2026 presidential race, bolstering Flávio Dino’s image as a strong security candidate. Meanwhile, the increase in tariffs on Brazilian products continues to divide Congress, with lawmakers split between government and opposition narratives on the economic consequences.

item.title: Erosão no Lulismo e denúncias contra Flávio podem favorecer 3º via, apontam institutos
item.description: The erosion of Lula’s support in the Northeast, among youth and in the C class, combined with allegations against Flávio Bolsonaro, may create space for a third way in the 2026 elections, with Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) as a potentially viable candidate, according to analysts from AtlasIntel and Quaest. Despite structural weaknesses in Lulism, Lula retains a lead in polls, while Flávio Bolsonaro’s scandals restrict his impact to the more informed electorate, undermining his anti-corruption narrative. The reorganization of the right and ongoing opposition weakness are seen as favorable conditions for a centrist alternative to emerge.

item.title: Lula ironiza Milei após críticas ao governo e STF: "Quem é esse cara?"
item.description: President Lula mocked Argentine President Javier Milei's criticisms of the Brazilian government and STF, asking 'Who is this guy?' during an interview. Milei had praised Flávio Bolsonaro as the only one who could 'stop Lulu', attacked Minister Alexandre de Moraes, and used offensive terms like 'bald trash'. The Brazilian government responded by summoning ambassadors for clarification, deeming Milei's remarks inappropriate and disrespectful.

item.title: PT aciona TSE contra Eduardo Bolsonaro por live sobre urnas eletrônicas
item.description: The Brazil of Hope Federation (PT, PV, PCdoB) filed a complaint with the TSE against Eduardo Bolsonaro for spreading false information about electronic voting machines during a 55-minute live stream with Fernando Cerimedo, identified as a major disinformation spreader. The petition requests immediate removal of the content, a ban on future similar posts, a fine of up to R$ 30,000, and daily fines for non-compliance. The federation claims the broadcast contained 11 false statements and is part of a coordinated strategy to delegitimize the TSE and prepare for challenging the 2026 election results.

item.title: Democracia Cristã lança pré-candidatura de Clariana Barão à Presidência
item.description: The Christian Democracy party (DC) launched the pre-candidacy of lawyer Clariana Barão for President of the Republic last Friday, the 24th. The announcement came after former Supreme Court Justice Joaquim Barbosa communicated his withdrawal from the electoral race days earlier.

item.title: Papo Antagonista: Jair de IA e Michelle de papelão
item.description: In Monday's edition of Papo Antagonista, the discussion centered on the PL's national convention, which officially nominated Flávio Bolsonaro as the party's presidential candidate. The event featured an AI-generated message from former president Jair Bolsonaro and a cardboard cutout representing former first lady Michelle Bolsonaro. The segment highlighted the theatrical and technologically mediated nature of the Bolsonarist campaign.

item.title: Doce Maravilha 2026 promete três dias de encontros inesquecíveis da MPB
item.description: The Doce Maravilha 2026 festival takes place from August 7 to 9 at the Jockey Club Brasileiro in Rio de Janeiro, celebrating Brazilian music with unprecedented performances, including Paulinho da Viola with Maria Bethânia, Caetano Veloso with Emicida, and tributes to Belchior and Selvagem?. Curated by Nelson Motta and produced by Luiz Guilherme Niemeyer of Bonus Track.

item.title: Convenções confirmam quatro candidatos em Apucarana até agora
item.description: Four candidates from Apucarana (PR) have been confirmed in party conventions to run for seats in the Paraná State Legislature and the Chamber of Deputies in the 2026 elections. The specific names were not provided in the content, but the confirmations occurred in recent party conventions. The focus of these races is regional representation at both state and federal levels.

item.title: Estudo diz que 87% dos deputados federais pretendem disputar reeleição
item.description: A DIAP survey shows 87.32% of Brazil's 513 federal deputies intend to run for re-election in 2026, the highest rate since 1990, signaling low turnover in the Chamber of Deputies. This trend is driven by incumbent advantages such as access to parliamentary amendments and priority in the Electoral Fund, combined with new electoral rules limiting candidacies. The study projects the next Congress (2027-2030) will closely resemble the current legislature.

item.title: Sem saidinha e visita íntima: Zema explica proposta de "super presídio"
item.description: Romeu Zema, presidential candidate from the Novo party, proposed hardening Brazil's prison system, including banning intimate visits and temporary furloughs for criminal organization leaders, and constructing a 'super prison' in the Amazon border region with Peru, Bolivia, and Colombia, where inmates would work for the Armed Forces. He also advocated classifying criminal groups as terrorists and criticized the Judiciary for failing to incarcerate criminals and military police for being demoralized.

item.title: Crédito do programa Move Brasil para comprar moto e bicicleta começa a valer
item.description: The Move Brasil program now allows delivery workers and motorcycle taxi drivers to access government-backed financing with reduced interest rates to purchase new motorcycles and electric bicycles produced in Brazil from 2024 onward. Conditions include monthly interest rates of 0.99% for men and 0.91% for women, up to four-year repayment terms, and first payments due 60 days after contract signing. Eligibility requires registration on gov.br, minimum activity time or formal employment, and credit approval by participating banks such as Banco do Brasil, Caixa, Honda and Yamaha.

item.title: Lula é questionado sobre Javier Milei e responde: quem é esse cara?
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) responded with irony when asked about criticisms from Argentine President Javier Milei, saying, 'Who is this guy?' as he arrived at the Itamaraty Palace to receive South Korean President Lee Jae-myung. The remark was made in a joking tone during a press briefing on Monday, the 27th. Lula avoided direct engagement with Milei’s critiques, opting for a lighthearted approach.

item.title: Eleições 2026: união entre TSE e Facebook prevê canais de denúncia e comunicação direta com eleitores
item.description: The TSE formalized a memorandum of understanding with Facebook Brasil to strengthen the fight against misinformation in the 2026 General Elections. The partnership, part of the Permanent Program to Combat Disinformation of the Electoral Justice, includes actions for prevention, identification, and containment of potentially illicit content, along with training for judges, servants, and political parties. The agreement covers Facebook, Instagram, Threads, and WhatsApp, aiming to disseminate reliable information and protect the integrity of the electoral process.

item.title: Caiado critica Milei e diz que ingerência externa é "inadmissível"
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado criticized Javier Milei's participation in the PL convention that endorsed Flávio Bolsonaro, calling foreign interference inadmissible and a violation of Brazilian sovereignty. He stated that elections must be decided solely by Brazilian citizens without foreign leader intervention. The remarks came after Milei insulted Lula and Alexandre de Moraes at the event, triggering a diplomatic crisis between Brazil and Argentina.

item.title: Flávio lidera na disputa com Lula em apenas uma faixa etária, diz pesquisa Datafolha
item.description: The Datafolha poll conducted in July 2026 shows Lula leading Flávio Bolsonaro 48% to 43% in a hypothetical second-round runoff, but Bolsonaro leads only among voters aged 35 to 44 (53% to 38%). Lula holds advantages among those aged 60+ (55% to 37%) and 45–59 (50% to 39%), while the 16–34 age groups show a technical tie within the margin of error.

item.title: Zema sobre Brasil sair do Brics: "Não precisa fazer parte do clubinho da China"
item.description: Presidential candidate Romeu Zema (Novo) argued that Brazil does not need to join the BRICS to maintain close commercial ties with China, calling the bloc 'China's little club'. He emphasized that Brazil should preserve its partnership with Beijing while seeking a more balanced relationship with the United States, criticizing Lula's differential treatment of the two nations. The remarks were made during Novo's national convention, which officially launched his 2026 presidential candidacy.

item.title: 'Quem é esse cara?', diz Lula ao ser questionado sobre declarações de Milei
item.description: Lula dismissed Javier Milei's remarks, asking 'Who is this guy?' when questioned about the Argentine president's attacks on him and Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes. Milei had called Lula a 'prisoner' and Moraes 'bald trash' during the PL convention that formalized Flávio Bolsonaro as a presidential candidate. Brazil responded by summoning ambassadors for consultations, while the Finance Minister stated Brazil's economy is stronger than Argentina's and labeled Milei a 'clown'.

item.title: Lulômetro: Desaprovação de Lula cai para 36%
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's (PT) disapproval rating dropped from 39% to 36% between July 14 and July 27, according to the Lulômetro, a daily tracking poll by O Antagonista and Real Time Big Data. The 'bad and terrible' evaluation index had peaked at 50% in April and 44% in May, signaling a recent improvement in public perception. However, the article does not specify which policies or events contributed to this decline in disapproval.

item.title: Janja apresenta cultura brasileira à primeira-dama sul-coreana
item.description: Brazilian First Lady Janja da Silva hosted South Korean First Lady Kim Hea-Kyung for a visit to the 'Festa de Luz: Brazilian Popular Festivals and Art' exhibition at the TCU Cultural Center, showcasing Brazilian culture through works by artists such as Alfredo Volpi and Beatriz Milhazes. The visit took place during the official agenda of South Korean President Lee Jae-myung, who is in Brazil alongside President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva to sign agreements and issue a joint statement on topics including AI, semiconductors, critical minerals, energy transition, health, defense, and bilateral trade expansion.

item.title: Ala do PT critica falas de ministros de Lula sobre Milei: "Fora do tom"
item.description: A faction within the Workers' Party (PT) criticized ministers Dario Durigan (Finance) and Guilherme Boulos (General Secretariat of the Presidency) for calling Argentine President Javier Milei a 'clown', 'Trump's lackey', and a 'pathetic caricature', stating these remarks were off-tone and contrary to President Lula's balanced strategy. The internal critique emphasizes that Lula maintained a posture of 'the only adult in the room', while the ministers unnecessarily escalated the political clash. Milei had attended the PL convention that formalized Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential candidacy, during which he attacked the Lula government and Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes.

item.title: Lula e presidente sul-coreano criam grupo por acordo Mercosul-Seul
item.description: Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and South Korean President Lee Jae-myung announced the creation of a working group to advance negotiations for a trade agreement between Mercosul and South Korea, reviving talks stalled since 2021. The group will be coordinated by Brazilian Vice President Geraldo Alckmin (PSB) and will identify sensitive issues to prevent them from blocking progress. Both leaders emphasized the potential for growth in agribusiness, noting bilateral trade reached $11 billion in 2025, and expanded cooperation to high-tech industry, supply chains, green and digital economies.

item.title: Ofensas de Milei no Brasil integram roteiro de golpe de Trump a favor dos Bolsonaro
item.description: Javier Milei's appearance at the PL convention in São Paulo was seen as part of a far-right international strategy led by Donald Trump to support Flávio Bolsonaro's 2026 candidacy. Milei insulted Lula and Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes, triggering a diplomatic crisis with Argentina and reinforcing the view that he acts as Trump's 'henchman' in Brazil. While he appeals to some economic liberals and antiwoke 'machosfera' groups, his electoral impact is limited due to widespread anti-Argentine sentiment in Brazil, especially after the World Cup.

item.title: Campanha de Zema avalia como ‘deselegantes’ críticas de Milei a ministros do STF
item.description: Members of Romeu Zema's (Novo) presidential campaign criticized Argentine President Javier Milei's remarks against STF Minister Alexandre de Moraes as 'inelegant' and limited to the Bolsonarist electorate. Although Zema is also critical of certain STF justices, he distanced himself from Milei's comments, calling foreign interference inappropriate and downplaying their electoral impact, which he views as already aligned with Flávio Bolsonaro (PL).

item.title: Eduardo Bolsonaro critica urna eletrônica com vídeo de Elon Musk
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro shared a video of Elon Musk criticizing the security of Brazil's electronic voting machines, endorsing Musk's stance and presenting him as a technical authority. The post comes amid renewed challenges to the electoral system by the Bolsonaro family, with Flávio Bolsonaro also expressing doubts about ballot integrity in a diplomatic event. Musk argued that electronic systems are vulnerable to coding flaws, digital intrusions, and future exploitation by advanced AI, advocating for paper ballots with identity verification.

item.title: Novo minimiza falta de coligações e aposta em campanha digital de Zema
item.description: The president of Novo, Eduardo Ribeiro, stated that the lack of major party alliances for Romeu Zema's presidential candidacy will be offset by a strong digital campaign, arguing that television airtime is no longer decisive in elections.

item.title: Série D ZeroUm: transmissões das oitavas chegam a 2,2 milhões de views
item.description: The Round of 16 of the Brasileirão Série D ZeroUm 2026 generated over 2.2 million views on YouTube, highlighted by Metrópoles Esportes' broadcasts. Eight teams advanced to the quarterfinals, competing for six spots in the 2027 Série C, with home-and-away matches starting August 8. The quarterfinal matchups are: Gama-DF vs São José-RS, ASA-AL vs Goiatuba-GO, ABC-RN vs Nacional-AM, and CSA-AL vs Uberlândia-MG.

item.title: PL brinca com fogo ao usar Bolsonaro de IA
item.description: The PL used artificial intelligence to generate a video featuring the image and voice of Jair Bolsonaro during the convention that formalized Flávio Bolsonaro's Senate candidacy, attempting to bypass judicial restrictions that bar the former president from active campaign participation. While tactically motivated, the move raises legal and ethical concerns by employing deepfake technology to reproduce a politically restricted figure, potentially constituting a violation of judicial order or an abuse of economic power.

item.title: Com ‘Pix Pensão’, devedor poderá ter a pensão debitada automaticamente da conta; entenda
item.description: The 'Pix Pension' bill would enable automatic, court-ordered Pix payments for child support from the debtor's account, aiming to reduce delinquency and judicial burden. President Lula has until April 30 to sign or veto PL 4.978/2023, which was approved by Congress.

item.title: Flávio questiona urnas por sentir “cheiro da derrota”, diz Tebet
item.description: Simone Tebet (PSB) accused Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) of questioning the integrity of electronic voting machines because he 'smells the scent of defeat' in the October 2026 elections, during the launch of Fernando Haddad's (PT) gubernatorial campaign in São Paulo. Tebet likened Flávio's stance to that of his father, Jair Bolsonaro, referencing the 2022 incident that led to the former president's ineligibility, and emphasized that the progressive coalition is uniting seven parties to win in São Paulo after their 2022 loss.

item.title: "O conflito aumenta": jornais argentinos repercutem crítica de Durigan a Milei
item.description: Brazilian Finance Minister Dario Durigan called Argentine President Javier Milei a 'clown' in response to Milei's attacks on the Brazilian government, escalating diplomatic tensions between the two countries. Argentine media, including Clarín and La Nación, highlighted the incident as another chapter in the diplomatic crisis, with La Nación stating that 'the conflict is increasing'.

item.title: Oposição da Argentina vê ataques de Milei contra Lula como irresponsabilidade contra parceiro comercial
item.description: Argentine President Javier Milei criticized Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva during the launch of Flávio Bolsonaro's candidacy, drawing backlash from Argentina's opposition, which views the remarks as irresponsible given Brazil's status as Argentina's largest trading partner.

item.title: Nunes Marques quer impor maior transparência aos institutos de pesquisas nas eleições deste ano
item.description: TSE President Kassio Nunes Marques aims to increase transparency of electoral pollsters by requiring disclosure of funding, survey locations, age ranges, and first poll date. The move targets preventing inexperienced firms from operating only during campaigns. The TSE plenary will rule in August on whether audiovisual resources are allowed in polls, following the suspension of a Flávio Bolsonaro survey deemed to induce responses.

item.title: Zema critica fala de Milei em evento de Flávio e diz que argentino foi deselegante
item.description: Presidential candidate Romeu Zema (Novo) criticized Argentine President Javier Milei's speech at the PL convention, calling it 'inelegant' for attacking President Lula and STF Minister Alexandre de Moraes. Zema emphasized the need for respect in diplomatic relations and political discourse, even among opponents.

item.title: A tática de Zema para tentar vencer o bolsopetismo
item.description: Romeu Zema, former governor of Minas Gerais, launched his presidential candidacy positioning himself as a viable alternative to bolsonarismo and lulismo (bolsopetismo). With limited party fund resources and inconsistent TV airtime, he aims to replicate his 2018 success when he was elected governor despite initial disadvantages. Members of the Novo party believe his reputation for efficient governance and appeal to moderate voters could again defy expectations.

item.title: Lula e Lee usam vínculo pessoal para aproximar Brasil e Coreia do Sul
item.description: Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) and South Korean President Lee Jae-myung strengthened the strategic partnership between Brazil and South Korea during a meeting at the Palácio da Alvorada, emphasizing personal similarities and cooperation in technology, education, industry, and defense. Lula praised the hospitality he received in Seoul and said Brazil aims to return 90% of the warmth shown, while Lee shared his background as a factory worker and a left-hand injury, drawing parallels with Lula’s life and reaffirming his commitment to vulnerable workers. Both leaders noted Lee’s planned visit to the ABC Metalworkers’ Union in São Paulo, a key site in Lula’s political and union history.

item.title: Nikolas sobre Flávio e Michelle: "Não estou entrando em bola dividida"
item.description: Federal deputy Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) stated he will not get involved in the dispute between Senator Flávio Bolsonaro and former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro, considering the matter settled. He emphasized his focus on opposing the left and removing the PT from power, saying he believes Flávio and Michelle have reconciled, as shown by her video appearance at the PL national convention.

item.title: Nunes Marques: “IA em campanha é lícita, mas não para prejudicar”
item.description: TSE President Kassio Nunes Marques stated that AI use in electoral campaigns is permitted by law, provided it is not used to harm candidates or spread false content. He declined to comment on the AI-generated video featuring Jair Bolsonaro's image and voice shown at the PL convention, citing that the TSE is still reviewing the case. The PT-led federation filed an action challenging the legality of the video, which urged support for Flávio Bolsonaro's candidacy.

item.title: Justiça Eleitoral pelo Brasil: TREs se mobilizam para as eleições de outubro
item.description: The Electoral Justice is intensifying preparations for the October 2026 elections across Brazil. In Tocantins, electoral court staff are undergoing advanced training on electoral systems and disinformation, while in Mato Grosso, inspections are being conducted at schools to ensure voting sites are ready for voters.

item.title: Flávio vê espólio de Jair Bolsonaro derreter no berço político da família
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), the PL's presidential candidate, is seeing a decline in his electoral performance in Rio de Janeiro, the Bolsonaro family's political stronghold. According to the Genial/Quaest poll, he is technically tied with Lula in a potential second-round runoff (38% to 35%), but his numbers are nearly 30 percentage points below what Jair Bolsonaro achieved against Haddad in 2018. In the Southeast, Flávio dropped 10 points in one month, from 41.2% to 30.7%, while Lula gains momentum, signaling the weakening of the former president's political legacy in the region.

item.title: Zema diz que Lula “laçou” Patrus e que PT dará vexame em MG
item.description: Romeu Zema (Novo) accused Lula of 'lassoing' Patrus Ananias as the PT's Minas Gerais gubernatorial candidate after other refusals, claiming the party will suffer a 'vexame' in the state. Zema linked Minas' fiscal crisis to the previous PT government (Fernando Pimentel, 2015-2018) and said he entered politics after seeing the PT 'destroy' the state, calling the current federal administration populist and lacking a future plan.
